version: V2 one bounded private source-footprint experiment; frozen before any V2 result
base: Final V1 Native00749e09; same seed discovery, original binary source, corridor gap/support rules and final expansion-only integration. Same input rasters/scales. No source oracles changed.
sourceView: Use the analyzer's unchanged original thresholded source, not either staff-erased mask. The experiment does not introduce a grayscale classifier.
continuations: For each original fixed-column corridor, inspect x within3staffspaces of its edges and y one staffspace beyond its traced endpoints. Build exact original vertical ink runs at every nonshaft column. A thin run has height<=ceil(.28space). Join runs on successive nonshaft columns when their intervals meet within the horizontal column distance; the only skipped columns may be the already observed physical shaft. Connected thin-run graphs are continued-path explanations only if horizontal span>=ceil(2space) and they reach at least2spaces outside either shaft edge. Preserve all run coordinates and widths. This is a conservative source path hypothesis, not exclusive staff/slur identity. It may abstain or overexplain thin head rims; such recall limits remain testable.
footprint: In a PRIVATE evidence mask only, exclude the physical shaft columns and those measured continued thin-run pixels. Compute complete8-connected residual ink components over the whole inspected corridor context. A prospective filled body must contact the actual shaft on at least2 original rows, cannot touch any context boundary, and must fit width<=2.5space,height<=1.5space. Opposite-side components merge only through an original fully black horizontal shaft row shared by their direct attachment sets. These compactness bounds apply to the complete observed residual component, not a cropped fit window.
filledBody: Require an actual filled original residual disk of integer radius max(1,ceil(.2space)) lying wholly outside the shaft, inside the complete residual footprint. This witnesses two-dimensional thickness unexplained by the continued thin paths; no ellipse sample/dilation votes. Retain exact residual pixel-run bounds, attachment rows, filled-disk coordinates and explained source-run graph in witness records. Unresolved source identities remain a limitation: the criterion is not a theorem of musical semantics.
glyphAndTieScope: Only filled bodies are accepted in V2. Hollow bowls/cavities abstain. Thin continuing ties remain separately recorded source paths; they are not included in body bounds and are never erased from ordinary analysis. A connected local descender/ascender left in the full residual component makes it noncompact; detached companion glyphs are not independently recognized in this bounded version. Thick connected glyphs remain an explicit adversarial risk, not a solved OCR claim.
multiHead: Deduplicate overlapping body alternatives, sort all accepted bodies on the same traced physical shaft, then construct ONE interval from first to last accepted body including every accepted intermediate body. Every staff core contacted by supported source shaft rows within that head-to-head interval receives the complete alternative. Bare continuing shaft beyond outer bodies is excluded. This repairs adjacent-pair truncation without giving lower structural-only cores ownership beyond the outer heads.
cancellation: Check during corridor, column-run, path union, source-mask, residual-component, filled-disk and span loops. Cancellation returns no new hypothesis.
gates: Run unchanged case176 and36four-core controls; independent29 plus attached addendum6; exactly the5 previously changed real pages. Require complete case176, no new lost old source pixels/ordinary component changes, rejection of all8 real false spans and attached pp/flat negatives, and full3head preservation if all three filled heads are certified. Report any other existing miss; do not tune within V2. Root alone runsfull39 if these bounded source checks support it.
promotion: No production changes. A clean bounded V2 may later be paired with frozen numbered-lineV2 only in a separately frozen experiment with unchanged source masks and exact source-pixel comparisons. No combined run authorized by this protocol alone.
